spendingPowerSource: 2024 ACS tract GeoJSON local join using business-license coordinates
businessPatternSource: Census ZIP Business Patterns totals files (2020, 2023)
permitSource: City of Chicago Building Permits aggregate by ZIP, trailing 24 months
parcelSource: Cook County Parcel Universe aggregate by ZIP and class
modelNotes: Business counts are measured from City of Chicago business-license records.
FTE, payroll, wage quality, and multiplier values are modeled estimates by license category, not verified payroll.
Official employment and payroll benchmarks use Census ZIP Business Patterns when available.
Resident spending power uses ACS population and income data; household counts may be estimated when only tract data is available.
Permit and parcel metrics are aggregate ZIP-level public-data signals and do not expose row-level property or owner records.
